summary: Completed source-to-draft follow-up: recommendation and staffing now form P1; the evidence comparison and limitation form P2; proposed actions and limits form P3. Source findings S1 and S2 are resolved without losing content. Parent pre-score review found the complete candidate faithful and useful. Native Human rose from 0.1958006% to 0.6336482%, a small absolute change, not validated authorship or general detector improvement. No necessary new repair.

document_analysis.structure: P1 states recommendation and its operating risk together. P2 gives Saturday's real attendance advantage and the records-only basis. P3 covers review, counting and the limits of completed repairs.
document_analysis.reasoning_specificity: All numeric comparisons and staff constraints survive; the recommendation remains contestable and the absence of a survey remains explicit.
document_analysis.voice_consistency: Contractions make the committee recommendation more ordinary without changing its cautious, practical stance. No invented personality or emotion.
document_analysis.rhythm_repetition: Longer P1 holds one dependency; P2 and P3 vary naturally with their different jobs. Repeated Wednesday/Saturday names prevent ambiguity rather than signalling an origin.
document_analysis.language_features: Natural professional English. 'I'd keep' expresses recommendation, 'could leave' keeps risk conditional, and 'suits' refers to convenience.
document_analysis.citations_provenance: Known AI source and rewrite. Parent separate-from-writer prescore report exists; this post-score analysis is self-review. No commercial output or human authorship claim.

findings.discriminating_evidence: Independent parent review and full source comparison support fidelity; they do not predict model behavior.
findings.reason: No remaining necessary repair; a new route would be an explicitly requested comparison, not defect repair.
